LanguageData.LP_Sub_Drifter.label: way of the drifter
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Drifter.description: A short gun and a blade: alternating cuts and shots, repositioning after every takedown, ending in a blade-and-two-shots combo.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Pistolero.label: way of the pistolero
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Pistolero.description: Two short guns: twin shots, fanning, return fire, and a high-noon duel.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Sniper.label: way of the sniper
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Sniper.description: Waits where enemies can't see: concealment, piercing shots, spotting for the squad, and a thousand-yard stare.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Vanguard.label: way of the vanguard
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Vanguard.description: Heavy weapons at the front: point-blank blasts, covering fire, breaching, and a steel storm.
